# Real Treasury

> Real Treasury is an independent advisory firm for corporate treasury teams. We help
> companies select a treasury management system (TMS) without vendor pressure — no vendor
> pays us for a recommendation — and we publish vendor-neutral research and education on
> treasury technology. Built by former practitioners with vendor-side experience.

Our selection method is ERR NOT: Education, Requirements, RFI, uNique demo script,
Obvious winner, Transformation. Real Treasury does not resell, implement or take fees
from technology vendors.

Site index: https://realtreasury.com/sitemap_index.xml

## Start here

- [How to Select a Treasury Management System](https://realtreasury.com/how-to-select-a-tms/): A practitioner walkthrough of TMS selection: the three market segments, the ERR NOT method, and the five mistakes that produce the wrong system.
- [The 5 Most Common Selection Failures and How to Avoid Them](https://realtreasury.com/tms-selection-mistakes/): No written requirements, falling for the demo, buying the salesperson, the easy button, buying on price. The five mistakes and how to avoid each one.
- [ERR NOT: the six-step selection method](https://realtreasury.com/errnot/): Education, Requirements, RFI, uNique Demo Script, Obvious Winner, Transformation. Real Treasury's six-step method for selecting treasury technology.
- [Treasury Tech Selection Guide](https://realtreasury.com/treasury-tech-selection-guide/): Every TMS vendor selling into North America, sorted into three segments, with a functionality matrix for each. Free, and no vendor pays for inclusion.

## Treasury technology explained

- [Data Flows of a TMS](https://realtreasury.com/data-flows-of-a-tms/): How a TMS moves data between banks, your ERP and market feeds, and which of those integrations decide whether a selection succeeds.
- [Payment Networks Explained](https://realtreasury.com/payment-networks-explained/): How ACH, wire, RTP and SWIFT differ on speed, cost, cut-off times and reversibility, and which one belongs in which treasury workflow.
- [Cash Tools Explained](https://realtreasury.com/cash-tools-explained/): A plain comparison of the tools treasury teams use to see and move cash, what each is genuinely good at, and where the overlaps cause wasted spend.
- [Real Treasury Explained](https://realtreasury.com/real-treasury-explained/): Why treasury technology selection stalls, how the ERR NOT method compresses it, and how Real Treasury is paid — we do not resell software or take commissions.

## Tools

- [Treasury Tech Portal](https://realtreasury.com/treasury-tech-portal/): Interactive treasury software selection tool. Filter TMS and treasury technology platforms by segment, features and fit, and build a shortlist.
- [Treasury Tech Market Map](https://realtreasury.com/treasury-tech-market/): An independent market map of the treasury technology landscape, used to compare categories of tool before comparing products.
- [Treasury Business Case Builder](https://realtreasury.com/rtbcb/): Build the internal business case for treasury technology spend, with the cost and benefit categories treasury teams are actually asked about.

## Method and workshops

- [How to Build a Demo Script: The ERR NOT Framework](https://realtreasury.com/err-not-demo-script/): How to build a vendor-agnostic demo script from your own prioritized requirements, using the ERR NOT method. Watch the session and take the worksheet.
- [The TMS RFP Trap](https://realtreasury.com/tms-rfp-trap/): A feature-checklist RFP rewards the vendor with the longest list, not the best fit. What to send instead, and how to score demos against your own requirements.
- [TMS Market Overview — North America](https://realtreasury.com/on-demand-workshop/): A recorded walkthrough of the North American TMS market: the segments, who fits which, and the questions to ask before you shortlist. No vendor pitch.
- [TMS Market Overview — EMEA](https://realtreasury.com/on-demand-workshop-emea/): A recorded walkthrough of the EMEA TMS market: the segments, who fits which, and the questions to ask before you shortlist. No vendor pitch.
- [Tech Selection Workshop](https://realtreasury.com/tech-selection-workshop/): A working session that helps treasury teams compare technology, avoid the common traps, and make an informed vendor decision.
